# Amazon Rekognition

Return fixture image analysis results and manage collection records and tags.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `rekognition` |
| Signing name | `rekognition` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2016-06-27` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Fixture-backed image analysis, local S3 reads and collection records |
| Selected operations | 12 of 75 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-rekognition) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Collections hold metadata and tags; face indexing, face and user search, and real image inference are unsupported.
- Video, custom models, DetectLabels feature and settings overrides, face attributes selection, text filters and quality filters are unsupported.
- Missing or ambiguous fixtures return InvalidParameterException.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
